caption: One continuous watchmaker workshop multishot scene. The same central subject, setting, material identity, lighting family, and event continuity should carry across all camera cuts. Source caption evidence: An elderly watchmaker with a neatly trimmed silver-gray beard, thick dark eyebrows, round brass-rimmed glasses, and a small dark mole on his left cheekbone works at a cluttered wooden bench under a warm tungsten desk lamp, wearing a deep-green wool vest over a cream shirt and a brown leather apron.
contrast_caption: A different unrelated subject, object set, location, lighting condition, or event replaces the scene between shots.
invariant_caption: The same elderly watchmaker persists across every shot: neatly trimmed silver-gray beard, thick dark eyebrows, round brass-rimmed glasses, a small dark mole on the left cheekbone, deep-green wool vest over a cream shirt, and a brown leather apron. The same cluttered wooden workbench, warm tungsten desk lamp, and shelves of antique clocks persist despite legitimate camera, framing, and action changes.
